script: Coca-Cola's recipe is so secret, its two guardians are banned from flying together. The original formula sits locked inside a vault in Atlanta, known only as Merchandise 7X. Only two executives on Earth know the complete recipe at any given time, and company policy forbids them from ever traveling on the same plane. If both died in the same accident, the exact formula could disappear forever. Even the master vault has a second layer, a sealed envelope inside it that can only be opened by a vote of the board of directors. Chemists have tried for over a century to reverse engineer the taste, and none have ever matched it exactly. The company moved the formula to a new vault in 2011, turning the transfer itself into a public spectacle. Coca-Cola's recipe is so secret, one plane crash could erase it completely.
